name: Special Operations Command
displayDescription: This gamepass gives you access to the Special Operations Command in Hamburg, which is specialized in dealing with armed criminals (Like SWAT in the US). The department includes two special armored vehicles (the BR-Titan and an Armored Truck), undercover police vehicles, special tools (A ladder and an M4 Carbine), a 30% higher shift payment, and a uniform with protective gear to stand against the most hardened criminals. Also, an exclusive sniper can be unlocked.

name: Motorcycles
displayDescription: This gamepass gives you access to motorcycles in the game. You can drive motorcycles as a citizen, car mechanic, police officer and firefighter. Motorcycles have fast acceleration and excellent maneuverability. All motorcycles also have a second seat for a companion.

name: Undercover Police
displayDescription: This gamepass gives you access to the undercover police department in Hamburg. The department includes undercover police vehicles, a 20% higher shift payment, and a special police uniform to catch criminals unnoticed!

name: Crime Boss
displayDescription: This gamepass makes you a crime boss in Hamburg. You become friends with the dealer, who will give you knuckledusters for free, a 25% discount on all items, 25% more money when selling stolen goods, and exclusive access to a sniper. You also get protective gear you can put on when you get a wanted level (in the criminal app). Also, your prison times will be 50% shorter.

name: Advanced Tuning Garage
displayDescription: This gamepass unlocks additional options for the tuning garage. You become best buddies with the mechanics, who will offer you custom vehicle and rim colors, additional engine, armor, and brake levels and special vehicle attachments. They will also provide you with a 50% discount on all vehicle repairs.

name: Electric Vehicles
displayDescription: This gamepass gives you access to electric cars, buses and trucks in the game. You can drive electric vehicles as a citizen, car mechanic, police officer, firefighter, bus driver and truck driver. Electric vehicles have fast acceleration and can be charged cheaply at any charging station.

name: Convertible Vehicles
displayDescription: This gamepass gives you access to convertible vehicles in the game. Enjoy the fresh wind as you drive through the city as a citizen or criminal. Convertible vehicles have detailed interiors and faster acceleration than other comparable vehicles.

name: Classic Cars
displayDescription: This gamepass gives you access to classic cars in the game. Ride through the city in style as a citizen, criminal, or police officer. Classic cars have faster acceleration than other comparable vehicles.

name: Athlete
displayDescription: This gamepass increases your stamina by 50% permanently.

name: Quads
displayDescription: This gamepass gives you access to all quads in the game. You can drive a Quad as a citizen, car mechanic, police officer, and firefighter. With quads, you can drive through the parks and rocky terrain. All quads also have a second seat for a companion.
